subject: Next steps: StrataVision POC scope & measurable success targets
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Miguel Santos <miguel@stratavision.com>
Cc: Jenna Lee <jenna@stratavision.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: StrataVision POC scope & measurable success targets

Miguel — thanks again for the time today. Good to meet Jenna and hear more about StrataVision's product goals. Per our discussion, I sketched a short, four‑week POC that validates both quality and operational economics before you commit to a longer deployment. Please review the proposed acceptance criteria and owners below and confirm what you'd like to change.

High-level objective:
- Validate that Redwood can meet StrataVision's latency and throughput SLOs while keeping per‑token costs within your target and maintaining generation quality for your summarization and intent flows.

Proposed success criteria (measurable):
- Latency: p95 <= 250 ms (end-to-end from app -> Redwood -> response) and p50 <= 90 ms.
- Throughput: sustain 60 req/s for 30 minutes (steady state) with 10% headroom for short bursts.
- Cost: average cost/token <= $0.0012 during the run (measured across all notebooked scenarios).
- Quality: intent classification accuracy >= 92% on brightline test set (n=500); summarization quality >= 4.0/5 average on blind human eval (n=200); hallucination incidents <= 3% per sample set.

Evaluation plan (4 weeks):
- Week 0 (prep): data sampling, query selection, environment access + keys.
- Week 1 (baseline): baseline model baseline benchmarks on your representative queries.
- Week 2 (integration): integrate Redwood runtime into your pipeline; run end-to-end scenarios.
- Week 3 (stress & economics): throughput runs, prefix/KV cache checks, cost/tokens breakdowns.
- Week 4 (validation & handover): blind eval, SLA readout, ops runbook and handoff.

Owners (Redwood / StrataVision):
- Redwood AM: Naomi Feldman (POC owner, cadence)
- Redwood SE: Ben Carter (integration, smoke tests)
- Redwood Platform: Karthik Iyer (performance tuning)
- StrataVision Technical: Miguel Santos (primary), Jenna Lee (CTO oversight)
- StrataVision Procurement: Linda Park (contracts)

Attachments: StrataVision-POC-Template.xlsx (POC checklist & instrumentation guide) attached.

Can you confirm the timeline windows (you mentioned a preference for an early June start) and whether the quality targets above reflect your internal expectations? If you need tighter latency or a different cost target we'll update the mutual action plan and sequence.

Next step suggestion: If OK, I'll circulate a single-sheet Mutual Action Plan and a shared Drive folder with test-case templates. Looking to lock an in‑lab start date by Friday.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0183
From: Miguel Santos <miguel@stratavision.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jenna Lee <jenna@stratavision.com>, Linda Park <linda@stratavision.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: StrataVision POC scope & measurable success targets

Naomi — appreciate the clear write‑up and the template. Jenna and I reviewed this morning. A few quick notes from our side that will change acceptance slightly:

- Latency: we'd like to tighten p95 to <= 220 ms if possible. Our front-end has a tighter budget for user‑facing flows.
- Throughput: we expect to see bursts up to 75 req/s (for 3–5 minutes) during peak window; sustaining 60 req/s is fine for steady state.
- Cost: your $0.0012/token estimate is OK as an initial target but our finance team prefers to see a goal at or below $0.0010/token (not a hard blocker for the POC but favorable).
- Quality: intent accuracy target holds. For summarization we can increase blind eval to n=300 if that helps confidence.

Timeline / procurement: Linda (cc'd) will own contracts; recommended start is the week of 1 Jun (internal approvals complete). If Redwood can commit to the tightened p95, we can aim to sign the MSA and start infra provisioning the week prior.

I've attached a short sample query file (StrataVision-Sample-Queries.csv) so you can validate tokenization and sample distributions early.

Would be great if Ben could prep a short checklist of what infra credentials/logs you'll need so we can hand those off to our platform team.

—Miguel
Miguel Santos
Director of Engineering, StrataVision
miguel@stratavision.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Miguel Santos <miguel@stratavision.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Jenna Lee <jenna@stratavision.com>, Linda Park <linda@stratavision.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: StrataVision POC scope & measurable success targets

Thanks Miguel — that's really helpful and we can align to the tightened targets. Below is an updated, actionable POC playbook with owners and immediate next steps. If that looks good I'll drop it into the Drive folder and send a DocuSign for the mutual action plan.

Updated acceptance criteria (redwood updated):
- Latency: p95 <= 220 ms (end-to-end), p50 <= 80 ms. We will measure from your production egress point to Redwood's response; instrumentation details in the attached template.
- Throughput: sustain 60 req/s steady state; support bursts to 75 req/s for up to 5 minutes without error rate increase > 1%.
- Cost: target average cost/token <= $0.00085 during benchmark runs (this assumes batching & prefix caching enabled; we'll show a breakdown by run).
- Quality: intent accuracy >= 92% (n=500); summarization blind eval n=300 with average rating >= 4.2/5; hallucination incidents <= 2% observed.

Evaluation and gating mechanics:
- We will run three benchmark profiles: 1) steady‑state 60 rps for 30 mins, 2) burst to 75 rps for 5 mins, 3) mixed user sample at real traffic distribution. Each run produces latency percentiles, per‑token cost, and quality snapshots.
- Pass condition: all three runs must meet latency + error rate + cost threshold AND blind eval quality meets stated thresholds. If a single run fails, we perform one remediation cycle (optimization knobs: quantization profile, batch sizing, KV cache tuning) and re-run within 72 hours.

Immediate next steps / owners (this week):
- Naomi Feldman (Redwood) — finalize PoC M.A.P., coordinate kickoff, weekly cadence.
- Ben Carter (Redwood SE) — list of infra artifacts needed (API keys, sample logs, preferred test harness). Ben will send checklist by EOD today.
- Karthik Iyer (Redwood Platform) — performance tuning playbook and observability hooks.
- Miguel & Jenna (StrataVision) — confirm test dataset and token budget; share dev credentials to drive folder.
- Linda Park (StrataVision) — procurement/contact for MSA (we'll route DocuSign).

Docs & attachments:
- I've uploaded the updated PoC template to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cStrata-PoC
- DocuSign (mutual action plan) will be sent once you confirm the timeline: https://www.docusign.com/embedded/sign?mem=abc123SV

Proposed kickoff window: week of 1 Jun 2026 — final signoff by 28 May to allow infra prep.

If that all looks good Miguel / Jenna please reply with a single-line confirm and Linda if procurement can target DocuSign by Friday.

Best,
